limits: Every new test poweroff invocation was replaced with a synthetic result or isolated Python child. No actual VBoxManage controlvm, selected-VM stop, boot, guest command or native owner startup occurred.

The three-second command budget and complete existing nine/ten-second stop path are unmeasured against real VBox poweroff. Command return and exit zero do not establish VM poweroff or runtime acceptance.

Approval strings, raw hashes and structural profile checks do not authenticate an issuer or prove external receipts true. Host ACLs, source/executable dependency integrity and independently supervised startup remain required.
A native stop remains available to its original bound owner after fencing, expiry or rollback. Such a late command does not renew authority or retroactively meet original stop deadlines.

VM hardware/isolation drift is not a precondition denial for emergency poweroff; exact original owner/lease/target and stop approval remain mandatory. Independent post-stop observations still require their fixed storage/disconnection profile.

Kernel stalls, filesystem flush/RLock waits, physical-power-loss durability and COM server lifecycle outside the query/command job remain unqualified. SQLite timeout and process waits are bounded independently, not a proof of hard real-time shutdown.

Legacy target/executable-only profiles cannot use the old native fallback. They must carry the current original-stop binding before future launch. No old frozen review bundle or measurement was rewritten.

Current stop revision 02 and host revision 04 packets are unarmed. Stop revision 01 and host revision 03 are earlier source snapshots; no source-cohort mixing or inferred activation permission is allowed.

The same-boot review proposal remains unadopted; current inspection attempts still stop. Guard creation, broker phase policy, actual backup/root/transfer/control/install and final M1-11 through M1-14/product evidence remain incomplete.
next_check: Prepare and qualify a separately launched original owner that survives controller death and polls original lease/fencing without renewal. Bind startup/failure/stop evidence before requesting any native target activation; pending design/creation decisions remain separate.
